thread:
maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/62110 — tiny prefetch/warmup flag to reduce coldstart latency on Dedicated. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before Friday merge window. TL;DR: adds config flag, default off, opt-in via service config. No model changes.
alex: cc @cheng for runtime, @paul for infra, @sara for security. can someone take first pass?
cheng: I can take this tomorrow AM. Quick Q: does this touch allocator or just routing?
maria: just routing + a small config shim. no allocator changes. added a unit test and a smoke script.
cheng: ok reading... looks small. will check kv warmup behavior.
paul: infra: looks fine from infra side, but pls add a canary flag and docs for rollout steps.
maria: added canary flag: warmup.canary=true in deployment yaml. updated runbook at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/runbooks/warmup.md
sara: security: quick check — we need to ensure no accidental KMS calls. Does warmup pull keys? if not, i'm good.
maria: no KMS. warmup primes model cache by requesting empty tokens. pasted config snippet: ```yaml
warmup:
  enabled: true
  canary: false
  endpoints: ['/v1/generate']
```
sara: thanks. LGTM from security once tests pass. leaving notes on PR.
cheng: runtime: couple minor nits inline re: backoff timing. not blocking. can we set default canary duration to 1h?
maria: done. set default to 3600s and added a telemetry flag: telemetry.warmup=true.
deploy-bot: canary scheduled: 2026-03-19T16:30:00Z in staging by @maria
alex: +1 from infra and security noted. @cheng please mark merge when runtime approves.
cheng: marking LGTM. merge after canary completes.
maria: :thumbsup: thanks all. will follow up if anything flaps during canary.
